title: Home Maintenance Receipts
user: Households that need to remember recurring upkeep and prove what was done, when, and with which documents when selling, insuring, or simply troubleshooting a home.
smallest_useful_product: Offline log of appliance/system, completed task, date, provider, cost optional, next-due date, and attachment hash/link; generate a one-page-per-system PDF report.
constraints: No external storage by default; make backup/export prominent; never claim a log satisfies warranty, permit, or insurance requirements.
